title: Explainable AI
description: Choose the explanatory question before the method; compare attribution, recourse and mechanism through falsifiable evidence, then carry that contract into agents and executable understanding.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Explainable AI treats explanations as claims that need evidence, rather than persuasive model narratives.
